questions.question: Please explain: *

questions.answer: An academic as well as personal challenge

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:

questions.answer: Not easy. I was finding the administration very chaotic.

questions.answer: I did not receive any assistance

Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: I was very lucky and found housing through a friend.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: It wasn't an opportunity to live on campus. But I really enjoyed living in an apartment with friends that I knew from before.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: The administration was very chaotic and I never received my student card. It all worked out in the end, but you have to insist with them.

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: I had filled out most of the registration documents before arriving and they didn't require much more than that.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Not much. They have an office entirely dedicated to taking care of international students, but the people working there are fairly incompetent and slow to answer at simple questions

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: I got all the classes I wanted

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Have faith ! Everything will work out even though little help is offered.

Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: The content of the English Courses are fairly easy,

questions.answer: Its very different teaching styles, and it took time to adapt to it, but both have its advantages as well as disadvantages.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: I never went out of Paris, but I would have loved to go to Normandy.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: For me it was quite easy

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer:
Engage in a sport or join an association. 
Don't be afraid to talk to French students, they are not as intimidating as they look :)   
Use the app "Bumble"

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer:
Language barriers 
Its a bigger, faster city

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: The intensity of an every day life, studying until late at libraries full of other students and then having wine at bars after.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Its a steep learning curve so trust your journey and have faith, insist with the administration, don't be afraid to take a chance

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: No

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Meaningful friendships

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: One semester felt too short. It would have suited me better to have had the option of staying one year.

questions.question: Any other comments?

questions.answer: Yes
